summary.text: Larry Rhoden is the Republican Governor of South Dakota. A rancher who served in the state House (2001–2009 and 2017–2019), the state Senate (2009–2015) and as lieutenant governor (2019–2025), he succeeded Kristi Noem in January 2025. In March 2026 he signed two property tax bills.

paragraphs.text: Raised on a farm; served in the South Dakota National Guard from 1978 to 1985.

Served in the state House (2001–2009, including four years as majority leader), the state Senate (2009–2015) and the state House again (2017–2019); lost the 2014 Republican U.S. Senate primary to Mike Rounds.
Elected lieutenant governor on Kristi Noem's ticket in 2018; became the 34th governor on Noem's resignation in January 2025.
